tools.name: catalog
tools.description: List the tools of this server with prices, data sources, licensing, daily limits and data freshness.

tools.name: entity_evidence_check
tools.description: For checks across several Japanese registries: FSA registers, warnings and enforcement cases, MOF asset-freeze list, EDINET filings, ISA support organizations, CAA actions, gBizINFO where connected. Gives each registry's status, version date, source, matches and what was not checked; a domain alone

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Re-fetch the stored result of a settled paid call by its receipt_id, for when the response was lost after payment. Free. Unknown or unsettled receipt ids return RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND. Results are kept for 30 days after settlement.

tools.name: entity_evidence_batch
tools.description: Same check as entity_evidence_check for 1-10 Japanese organizations in one call (by corporate number, exact name or registration number): per company the full evidence with each section's source, retrieval time, version date and what was not checked, plus a summary counting resolved, name-only, ambi

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "entity_evidence_check" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
